[USER] User is interested in exercises that target core muscles.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Core strength is essential for overall fitness and stability.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested exercises to target core muscles include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Plank: Hold for 30-60 seconds.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Russian twists: 3 sets of 12-15 reps.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Leg raises: 3 sets of 12-15 reps.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Bicycle crunches: 3 sets of 12-15 reps.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Pallof press: 3 sets of 12-15 reps.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Woodchoppers: 3 sets of 12-15 reps.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Side plank: 3 sets on each side for 30-60 seconds.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Bird dog: 3 sets of 12-15 reps.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Superman: 3 sets of 12-15 reps.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Kettlebell swings: 3 sets of 12-15 reps.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Reminders: Start with lower reps and sets, engage core muscles, breathe naturally, warm up and cool down.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Incorporate these exercises into the routine 2-3 times a week.
